Ed Sheeran addresses Gaza conflict after Macklemore controversy

Pop star Ed Sheeran spoke out about the Gaza situation during his first concert following a controversy involving rapper Macklemore. Sheeran described the war in Gaza as "catastrophic and unjustifiable." He apologized to concertgoers, stating, "I'm so, so sorry." Macklemore had previously supported Palestinians and pledged $1 million to a Gaza children's charity, matching a donation from Ms. Rachel. Artists in Gaza have painted murals honoring Macklemore for his support.
